label: P1.30 Budget Guard Assessment — Gates F, G, H, I

gate_f_request_budget.requirement: max_requests=100 enforced atomically before each real provider call
gate_f_request_budget.current_state: No request counter. No enforcement. Any number of real calls would be made without guard.

gate_g_cost_budget.requirement: max_cost_cny=100 enforced with atomic accumulator before each real provider call
gate_g_cost_budget.current_state: No cost accumulator. Token usage not captured in DeepSeekClient. Cannot compute cost.

gate_h_concurrency_rate_limit.requirement: PI_REAL_PROVIDER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2, rate limit configured, timeout set
gate_h_concurrency_rate_limit.current_state: No concurrency limiter for real provider. No rate limit handler. No explicit timeout on OpenAI client.

gate_i_provider_fail_closed.requirement: PI_REAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false → zero real calls regardless of live selection
gate_i_provider_fail_closed.current_state: Flag does not exist in Settings. No fail-closed guard in DeepSeekClient or call path. Real provider is currently inactive only because provider_mode=staging_replay is set at orchestration level — but there is no explicit PI_REAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false kill that would prevent activation if mode were changed.

p1_31_implementation_plan.phase: Implement before P1.31 real provider testing

steps.task: Implement RequestBudgetGuard with Redis atomic counter (INCR with pre-check)
Implement CostAccumulator with Redis INCRBYFLOAT and budget check
Wire RequestBudgetGuard into Pi agent call path before DeepSeekClient.chat()
Add ProviderCircuitBreaker: opens on budget breach or credential failure
Set explicit timeout on OpenAI client (e.g., timeout=20.0)

steps.file: backend/app/routers/ (new or extend existing canary router)

current_provider_mode_safety: staging_replay is currently safe because real LLM API calls only occur when pipeline explicitly routes to Pi execution. In staging_replay mode, Pi agent shadow-runs but uses pre-recorded/mock responses. No real provider calls occur.
verdict: Budget guard infrastructure NOT IMPLEMENTED. Gates F, G, I FAIL. Real provider cannot be safely activated until implementation complete.
